[F005] I implemented F005 as a new pure-core module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/upgrade_report.py` exposing `assemble_upgrade_report(manifest, marker, predicate_registry)` that returns an `UpgradeReport{summary, required[], advisory[], migration_status[]}` with no CLI dependency. The summary carries `installed_commit` (git `rev-parse --short HEAD`, `"unknown"` off-git), `latest_release_id`, `last_seen_release`/`last_seen_commit` (sourced from F004's displayed acknowledgement so they're null on an absent marker per D042/D023), `pending_required`/`pending_advisory`, `update_state` (count matrix: required_pending > advisories_pending > up_to_date, `unknown` for an empty manifest), and an UPSTREAM block computed read-only from locally-known refs via an injectable `GitProbe` seam that exposes only `rev-parse`/`rev-list` — there is no fetch entrypoint, so the no-network-fetch invariant (D016) is structural and the matching test asserts no `fetch`/`pull` call is ever issued. Required actions are marked pending iff `status_probe` is unsatisfied AND `applies_when` holds (marker-independent, D004); both `required[]` and `advisory[]` use one pinned `ReportItem` shape (D041) carrying the stable id `upgrade:<release>:<action>`, ordered commands, success/failure copy, `introduced_commands` (D022/D033), the resolved `applies`/`satisfied` values plus the ORIGINAL `applies_when`/`status_probe` keys (D046), while `migration_status[]` lists every probe-backed action with its state (pending/satisfie
